roadmap.title: Chapters 1–2
roadmap.description: Start on any difficulty. Save before the homeless men’s drinks errand and give Gold Champagne to the champagne requester.

roadmap.title: Chapters 3–4
roadmap.description: Before entering Odyssey, complete the scouting conversations. Keep a save from before scouting until the Chapter 4 negotiation reward.

roadmap.title: Chapters 5–6
roadmap.description: Save before Cafe Alps and complete Oda’s etiquette sequence. Start Real Estate Royale and collect revenue between other activities.

roadmap.title: Chapters 7–8
roadmap.description: Save before buying the story takoyaki and wait more than 15 minutes before returning. Start Club Sunshine and develop its roster.

roadmap.title: Chapters 9–10
roadmap.description: Save before the Tojo headquarters escape and defeat three enemies with partner Heat Actions.

roadmap.title: Chapters 11–12
roadmap.description: Save before the Nikkyo raid. Break the safes beside the stairs before going upstairs.

roadmap.title: Chapters 13–14
roadmap.description: Save before the Chapter 13 CAL shop visit. Shoot the afro-haired man during the highway chase.

roadmap.title: Chapters 15–16
roadmap.description: Save before entering Serena as Majima and deliberately fail Reina’s first bottle-attack prompt.

roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.description: Complete the final chapter and preserve your clear data for Premium Adventure.

roadmap.title: Premium Adventure cleanup
roadmap.description: Load the cleared save into Premium Adventure. Finish businesses, substories, abilities, equipment parts, and the Completion List. Switch characters and time at the office or Sunshine backroom phones.

roadmap.title: Climax Battles
roadmap.description: Clear all 32 preset battles from the title menu.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough
roadmap.description: Start a fresh New Game on Legend. Save frequently and stock healing items before each long story battle.

roadmap.title: All achievements
roadmap.description: Finish any remaining achievements to unlock the final completion award.

achievements.description: Obtain all other achievements
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 54 Yakuza 0 achievements.

steps.text: Finish every other achievement, including Legend difficulty and Climax Battles.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Legend Difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the main story with the difficulty set to Legend.

guide.context: A story game over returns you to your latest manual save.

steps.text: Clear the story once to unlock @mechanic{Legend}. From the title menu, select New Game and choose Legend; New Game+ cannot be used.
Buy health and damage upgrades as you earn money. Use Kiryu’s Beast style for groups and Majima’s Breaker style to interrupt attackers.
Keep healing and Heat-restoring items stocked before story battles. Save at phone booths frequently, especially before the Chapter 4 and 8 escorts and Chapter 13 car chase.

achievements.description: Get started with Real Estate Royale
achievements.summary: Collect the first Real Estate Royale payout as Kiryu.

steps.text: In Chapter 5, finish the @mechanic{Real Estate Royale} introduction at the @loc{Sugita Building} and collect the first payout.

achievements.description: Get 100% share in any area
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu’s Real Estate Royale market share to 100% in one district.

steps.text: Buy properties in the @loc{Leisure King} area and use advisors to improve their ranks between collections.
Resolve the area’s story events and keep buying or upgrading properties until its market share reaches 100%. Losing a minigame challenge only costs shares; more investment can recover them.

achievements.description: Purchase the most expensive property
achievements.summary: Buy the Disco City Boy property for ¥1,228,800,000.

steps.text: Advance @mechanic{Real Estate Royale} until the @loc{Media King} area opens. Collect ¥1,228,800,000, then buy @loc{Disco City Boy} from its street frontage.

achievements.description: Get started with Cabaret Club Czar
achievements.summary: Finish Majima’s first Cabaret Club Czar shift.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, complete the opening @mechanic{Cabaret Club Czar} shift at @loc{Club Sunshine}.

achievements.description: Get over 1,000 fans in any area
achievements.summary: Build a Cabaret Club Czar fanbase of more than 1,000 in one area.

steps.text: Run @loc{Club Sunshine} shifts targeting the @loc{Mars} area. Match hostesses to customer requests and buy nearby business partnerships until that area has more than 1,000 fans.

achievements.description: Max out the level of a platinum hostess
achievements.summary: Raise one platinum hostess to level 40.

steps.text: Keep @npc{Yuki} working shifts at @loc{Club Sunshine}. Rest her when her condition drops.
Use her available Special Training between shifts, then keep earning shift experience until her level reaches 40.

achievements.description: Get over 50% on your Completion List
achievements.summary: Complete more than half of the in-game Completion List.

steps.text: Work through unchecked tasks in the pause menu’s @mechanic{Completion List}. Combine story progress, substories, businesses, and minigames until the percentage passes 50%.

achievements.description: Get 100% on your Completion List
achievements.summary: Finish all 374 tasks on the in-game Completion List.

steps.text: Load your cleared save into @mechanic{Premium Adventure}. Use the Completion List in the pause menu to track unfinished tasks for both characters.

Finish Adventure tasks: buy every required meal and drink, gather 45 telephone cards per character, watch all 30 video clips, and reach 50 Dream Machine uses. For each woman’s cards, collect A before looking for B, then B before C.

Finish Battle tasks with both characters. Rotate through all eight fighting styles for the 200-enemy goals, vary Heat Actions, and track the 100-weapon and 70-gear collections. Complete the coliseum’s 50 tournament wins and defeat its 25 different opponents.
Finish both business checklists and all 100 substories. Upgrade Kiryu’s 50 properties to S rank. Complete each platinum hostess’s Special Training to open her substory.

Clear the minigame targets shown on each character’s list. Disco requires three stars on every song at every difficulty; karaoke requires 90 or more points, using Lively Interjections where offered. Cash out gambling sessions while ahead to register winnings.

For mahjong, aim for closed hands and declare Riichi when one tile from a win. A Full Straight uses three sequences of the same suit: 123, 456, and 789. Add another meld and a pair to complete the hand. Finish the named-hand, win-count, and money targets separately.

Use the [area maps and minigame checklists](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667240702) for remaining card locations, unlocks, and score targets. Check both characters’ lists for any task still incomplete.

achievements.description: Complete 10 substories
achievements.summary: Finish a total of 10 substories.

steps.text: Complete side stories around town and check finished entries in the @mechanic{Substories} menu. Work toward a combined total of 10.

achievements.description: Complete 40 substories
achievements.summary: Finish a total of 40 substories.

steps.text: Continue side stories as Kiryu and Majima until 40 are finished in total.

achievements.description: Complete all substories
achievements.summary: Finish all 100 substories across Kiryu and Majima.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Premium Adventure} to finish Kiryu’s 60 substories and Majima’s 40. Check the Substories menu for gaps.

Equip a @item{Trouble Finder} to display available substory markers. Kiryu earns one from @mechanic{The Tax Lady} after defeating the Electronics King. Majima earns one by completing the @npc{Komian chef} friendship; bring the requested Salmon, Eel, and Softshell Turtle.

Complete the Pocket Circuit rival races, all six platinum hostess training lines, the Telephone Club’s seven substory outcomes, and both characters’ trainer and friendship stories. Use the [substory location list](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1667240702) to find remaining starts.
Once each character has finished every other substory, accept the Amon invitation and defeat that character’s Amon opponent.

achievements.description: Spend one billion yen
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative ¥1,000,000,000.

steps.text: Buy properties, abilities, and equipment searches as you progress. Their costs build toward the ¥1,000,000,000 spending total.

achievements.description: Throw away money on the street
achievements.summary: Use Cash Confetti to scatter money on the street.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Cash Confetti} from @npc{Mr. Moneybags} during Chapter 6, then use the money-scatter command on a street.

achievements.description: Throw away a total of five million yen.
achievements.summary: Scatter a total of ¥5,000,000 with Cash Confetti.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Cash Confetti} 50 times in total. Each throw costs ¥100,000, so keep ¥5,000,000 available if starting from zero.

achievements.description: Pick up a telephone card.
achievements.summary: Collect one telephone card.

steps.text: Pick up the flashing @item{Chika Arimura A} card beneath the flag beside @npc{Pocket Circuit Fighter} inside the @loc{Pocket Circuit Stadium}.

achievements.description: Watch a sexy video.
achievements.summary: Watch one video clip at Gandhara.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{How to Train Your Dominatrix} on @loc{Pink Street North} to unlock Ayu Sakurai’s clip, then watch that clip at @loc{Gandhara}.

achievements.description: Get a top-grade item from a Dream Machine
achievements.summary: Receive a ten-star prize from a Dream Machine.

guide.context: The prize is random, so several purchases may be needed.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Dream Machines} priced at ¥1,000,000 when you find them. Keep trying until a prize displays ten stars.

achievements.description: Complete one training mission with each master.
achievements.summary: Complete at least one training assignment from each of the six fighting masters.

steps.text: As Kiryu, train with @npc{Bacchus} in @loc{Tenkaichi Alley} and @npc{Kamoji} at @loc{Shichifuku Parking Lot}. Buy nearby ability nodes if a lesson is unavailable.
Take a taxi to @loc{Tokyo Pier} for @npc{Miss Tatsu}. Finish her paid mannequin exercises until she offers a job, then complete that job; the practice sessions alone do not count.
As Majima, finish @npc{Komeki}’s lesson in @loc{Ashitaba Park}. Visit @loc{The Dragon and Tiger} for @npc{Fei Hu}’s training and the @loc{Shofukucho West} back alley for @npc{Areshi}’s lesson.

achievements.description: Purchase ten or more abilities.
achievements.summary: Buy at least 10 ability upgrades.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Abilities} and spend money on 10 unlocked nodes. Cheap upgrades in the starting styles count.

achievements.description: Obtain all abilities for every style.
achievements.summary: Unlock every ability in Kiryu’s and Majima’s six regular fighting styles.

steps.text: Finish both business storylines to remove the remaining ability locks, and complete every lesson from the six fighting masters.
Buy the remaining nodes in Kiryu’s Brawler, Rush, and Beast trees and Majima’s Thug, Slugger, and Breaker trees. The two Legend-style trees are excluded.

If money runs short, use Kiryu’s @mechanic{Deep Pockets} CP upgrade and farm @enemy{Mr. Shakedown}: lose money to him, then defeat him to recover a larger payout. Slime Guns or Zap Guns make the rematch easier.

achievements.description: Get five or more play bonuses fighting a single enemy.
achievements.summary: Earn at least five play bonuses against one enemy.

steps.text: Fight with varied attacks, environmental weapons, and Heat Actions. Aim to trigger five of the on-screen play bonuses against the same enemy; the Chapter 1 room full of tables and chairs is an early opportunity.

achievements.description: Defeat Mr. Shakedown for the first time.
achievements.summary: Win a fight against Mr. Shakedown.

steps.text: Find @enemy{Mr. Shakedown} walking around town. Bring healing items and a @item{Zap Gun} or @item{Slime Gun}, then keep your distance while firing and defeat him.

achievements.description: Get the best weapon search results report.
achievements.summary: Receive a “Crazy Unbelievable Success!” equipment-search report.

steps.text: As Majima, send search agents from @loc{The Dragon and Tiger} in Sotenbori. Invest extra money in searches and keep collecting results until a report reads “Crazy Unbelievable Success!”.

achievements.displayName: Eye of the Dragon and Tiger
achievements.description: Obtain all equipment parts.
achievements.summary: Collect all 96 types of equipment parts.

steps.text: Open the equipment-parts section of the Completion List to identify missing types. As Majima, compare those names with the search results offered by agents at @loc{The Dragon and Tiger}.
Collect each agent’s guaranteed part first, then fund searches whose possible rewards include a missing part. Spend extra money to shorten waits when you can afford it.
For @item{Godslayer Charm}, watch for @loc{Kowloon Walled City} in East Asia. Run other searches to refresh the available destinations until it appears.
If common parts stop appearing, remove search-boosting accessories and try again. Keep checking off new types until all 96 have been collected.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 or more opponents in Endless Rout.
achievements.summary: Defeat at least 30 opponents in a single Endless Rout run.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Bed of Styx} coliseum in Sotenbori after its Chapter 11 introduction. Win Standard tournaments until your rank reaches B.
Select @mechanic{Endless Rout}, choose rules that allow your preferred style and equipment, and defeat 30 opponents without ending the run. Buy healing between rounds when needed.

achievements.description: Play every minigame.
achievements.summary: Take part in every minigame.

steps.text: Play batting at @loc{Yoshida Batting Center}, bowling at @loc{Mach Bowl}, pool and darts at @loc{Vincent} or @loc{Shot Bar STIJL}, disco at @loc{Maharaja}, and karaoke at @loc{Heroine} or @loc{Utahime}.
Try @mechanic{Pocket Circuit}, the @loc{Teltel Boys Club}, and catfighting at @loc{JCC}. Fish at both the @loc{Tokyo Pier} and @loc{Sotenbori River}.

At the SEGA arcades, play @mechanic{Out Run}, @mechanic{Space Harrier}, and @mechanic{UFO Catcher}. Finish @npc{Luka}’s arcade friendship to unlock @mechanic{Super Hang-On}, and @npc{Kyoko}’s to unlock @mechanic{Fantasy Zone}; play both new games.
Play @mechanic{mahjong} at Orchid Palace or Jambalaya and @mechanic{shogi} at Shoten or with the player in southwest Sotenbori.
Visit the @loc{Sotenbori casino} for poker, baccarat, blackjack, and roulette. After West Park opens in Chapter 10, visit its gambling area for cee-lo, cho-han, koi-koi, and oicho-kabu.

achievements.description: Go on a date with a girl you met at the telephone club.
achievements.summary: Complete a successful date with a woman from the Telephone Club.

steps.text: As Kiryu, play the telephone game at @loc{Teltel Boys Club}. Choose flattering responses and finish the conversation to arrange a meeting.
Aim for @npc{Riku}, the young-sounding caller in a blue bikini. At the meeting, choose the woman in front and finish her substory. If the call produces a different woman, try another call.

achievements.description: Complete every disco song on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish each of the five disco songs on any difficulty.

steps.text: At @loc{Maharaja}, finish Friday Night, Queen of Passion, I’m Gonna Make Her Mine, I Wanna Take You Home, and Koi no DISCO QUEEN. Easy is sufficient; a three-star rating is unnecessary for this achievement.

achievements.description: Win ten bets on three-round tournaments at JCC.
achievements.summary: Win 10 complete three-match tournaments at JCC.

guide.context: Wins accumulate across tournaments; a loss does not erase earlier victories.

steps.text: Visit @loc{JCC} in Theater Square after it opens in Chapter 6. Bet on @npc{Jennifer} and win all three matches of a tournament.
Choose attacks that counter the opponent’s strongest hand. Follow the button prompts for ties, and keep entering tournaments until you have 10 tournament wins. Individual match wins are insufficient.

achievements.description: Win all Pocket Circuit races.
achievements.summary: Win the seven official Pocket Circuit races.

steps.text: As Kiryu, speak to @npc{Pocket Circuit Fighter} inside the @loc{Pocket Circuit Stadium} near Shichifuku Street West. Enter the official races, starting with the Introductory Race.

Buy new parts from the stadium shop as victories expand its stock. For early builds, buy @item{Soft Tires} at Don Quijote and unlock the Kamuro Dealer through @mechanic{Password Protected} for the ¥10,000,000 @item{High Torque Motor 2.0}.

Use the [race-by-race car setups and part locations](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1462272893) to clear Little Racers’ Cup, Rookies’ Race, Pro-Am Race, Experts’ Race, Champions’ Cup, and King of Speed Cup. Avoid boosting in the later races if the car leaves the track.
Win all seven official events. Rival substory races are separate and do not count toward this achievement.

achievements.description: Reach Kamurocho in December 1988.
achievements.summary: Reach Kamurocho in December 1988.

steps.text: Finish the opening Chapter 1 scenes until Kiryu is free to explore Kamurocho.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 2 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Give Gold Champagne to the homeless man requesting champagne in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Give Gold Champagne to the homeless man requesting champagne in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Save before completing Chapter 2’s drinks errand for the homeless men.
Buy @item{Gold Champagne} for ¥20,000 at @loc{Don Quijote} and give it to the man requesting champagne. If you deliver the cheaper bottle instead, reload your earlier save.

achievements.displayName: A Matter of Life or Death
achievements.description: Finish Chapter 4 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 4 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 4 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Secure ideal negotiation terms with Yamagata.
achievements.summary: Secure ideal negotiation terms with Yamagata.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, save before scouting @loc{Odyssey}. Speak to @npc{Matsu the Barker} at Bishamon Bridge, the @npc{College Hostess Hopeful} in Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall, and the two men on Shofukucho South before entering the club.
During the look-around inside Odyssey, examine the three occupied tables and the empty table before advancing the conversation.
Keep your scouting save until you return to the Grand and speak to the floor manager in Chapter 4. If the achievement fails to unlock, reload that save and redo the scouting.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 6 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 6 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 6 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Complete Oda’s Chapter 5 business meeting without an etiquette mistake.
achievements.summary: Complete Oda’s Chapter 5 business meeting without an etiquette mistake.

steps.text: Before entering @loc{Cafe Alps} with @npc{Oda} in Chapter 5, save your game.
Choose the table near the back with four chairs, then “Take the Nearest Seat.” When asked for an order, choose “Nothing.”
Pass the button prompt when presenting the business card. Finish the conversation; reload your save if you make a wrong choice or miss the prompt.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 8 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 8 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 8 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Keep the Chapter 7 story takoyaki undelivered for more than 15 unpaused real-time minutes after purchasing it.
achievements.summary: Keep the Chapter 7 story takoyaki undelivered for more than 15 unpaused real-time minutes after purchasing it.

steps.text: Save before buying the story-requested takoyaki in Chapter 7.
After buying it, stay in the unpaused game for more than 15 minutes without returning to the delivery marker. Wait for the achievement before continuing. If you deliver too early, reload the save.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 10 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 10 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 10 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Defeat three enemies with cooperative Heat Actions alongside Oda or Tachibana.
achievements.summary: Defeat three enemies with cooperative Heat Actions alongside Oda or Tachibana.

steps.text: In Chapter 10, save before leaving @loc{West Park} with Oda. Bring Heat-restoring drinks for the @loc{Tojo Clan headquarters} escape.
When @npc{Oda} or @npc{Tachibana} holds an enemy, approach with enough Heat and use the cooperative Heat Action. Avoid hitting the held enemy with ordinary attacks.
Defeat three enemies this way before leaving the headquarters. Keep enemies alive while waiting for grabs; reload your saved game if you finish the escape without the achievement.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 12 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 12 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 12 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Break open a Nikkyo Consortium cash safe during the Chapter 12 raid.
achievements.summary: Break open a Nikkyo Consortium cash safe during the Chapter 12 raid.

steps.text: Save before the Chapter 12 raid on the @loc{Nikkyo Consortium} inn.

After the fan-wielding enemy near the stairs, stop before going upstairs. Strike the two small safes beside the staircase until they open and the achievement appears. If you pass the stairs without opening a safe, reload your earlier save.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 14 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 14 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 14 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Shoot down the afro-haired yakuza during the Chapter 13 highway chase.
achievements.summary: Shoot down the afro-haired yakuza during the Chapter 13 highway chase.

steps.text: In Chapter 13, save before entering the @loc{CAL} shop and starting the chase sequence.

Watch the right side of the road for a car carrying a white-suited man with an afro. Activate @mechanic{Heat Eye} and shoot him before the car disappears. If he escapes, reload your save; on lower difficulties, losing the chase also lets you retry.

achievements.description: Finish Chapter 16 of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish Chapter 16 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the Chapter 16 story and reach its results screen.

achievements.description: Let Reina’s bottle attack hit Majima during the Chapter 15 fight.
achievements.summary: Let Reina’s bottle attack hit Majima during the Chapter 15 fight.

steps.text: Save before entering @loc{Serena} as Majima in Chapter 15.

During the fight with @npc{Nishiki}, deliberately miss the first button prompt for @npc{Reina}’s bottle attack. The later prompt for the healing drink is different. If you dodge her attack, reload your save.

achievements.description: Finish the final chapter of the main story.
achievements.summary: Finish the final chapter of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the final story battles and watch the ending.

achievements.description: Finish the entire Real Estate Royale business storyline.
achievements.summary: Finish the entire Real Estate Royale business storyline.

steps.text: At the @loc{Sugita Building}, assign staff, collect rent, and invest in owned properties. Buy more properties to grow each district’s market share.

Follow the district events as shares rise and defeat the Leisure, Electronics, Pleasure, Gambling, and Media Kings. A failed minigame challenge only costs shares; recover them through further investment.
Finish the Finance King confrontation and the business ending to unlock Kiryu’s @mechanic{Dragon of Dojima} style.

achievements.description: Finish the entire Cabaret Club Czar business storyline.
achievements.summary: Finish the entire Cabaret Club Czar business storyline.

steps.text: Run shifts at @loc{Club Sunshine}, match hostesses to customers, and buy partnerships to expand the fanbase. Train platinum hostesses between shifts and rotate tired staff out to recover.
Build enough fans to challenge Mars, Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, and Moon. Win each rival battle by earning more money; use Fever to protect busy tables from rival interference.
Complete the final Kotomi events after the Five Stars to unlock Majima’s @mechanic{Mad Dog of Shimano} style.

achievements.description: Have a bystander light Kiryu’s cigarette after reaching 100% Real Estate Royale market share in one area.
achievements.summary: Have a bystander light Kiryu’s cigarette after reaching 100% Real Estate Royale market share in one area.

steps.text: After reaching 100% market share in the @loc{Leisure King} area, visit @loc{Tenkaichi Street} near Serena in the evening.
Stand beside a person who bows to Kiryu and leave the controls alone until Kiryu smokes and the bystander lights his cigarette.

achievements.description: Clear all 32 Climax Battles.
achievements.summary: Clear all 32 Climax Battles.

steps.text: After finishing the story, choose @mechanic{Climax Battles} from the title menu. Clear the available Proving Grounds, Melee Battles, and Millionaire Battles, then finish the Ultimate Battles that open.
Read each battle’s rule before starting. Use the supplied equipment and styles: the first Proving Grounds challenge requires weapon damage, including the cannon.
In @mechanic{Proving Grounds 6}, knock enemies down with Breaker headspin attacks while staying clear of their wake-up attacks. Avoid being knocked down so the money bonus grows.

In @mechanic{Proving Grounds 8}, health drains and styles change automatically. Use dropped weapons and save Heat Actions for dangerous enemies; Heat Actions pause the drain. Retry the battle as needed.

achievements.description: Defeat both So Amon and Jo Amon.
achievements.summary: Defeat both So Amon and Jo Amon.

steps.text: Finish Kiryu’s other 59 substories and Majima’s other 39. Each receives an invitation; take a taxi to the @loc{Bullfighting Arena} as the invited character.
Save before each fight and bring healing items, Heat-restoring drinks, and strong weapons. Fight @enemy{So Amon} as Kiryu and @enemy{Jo Amon} as Majima.
Against So, avoid the cannon and laser. When the helicopter starts dropping items, collect the golden invincibility bottles before attacking; retreat while So has that protection.
Against Jo’s dagger phase, use blade-resistant gear and Majima’s Mad Dog counter if available. Win both fights for the achievement.
